sources.games: 370 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 50.0%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py slark.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Eye of Skadi, Bloodthorn, Silver Edge, Monkey King Bar.
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 93 (Essence Shift, Shadow Dance), 44 (Phantom Assassin: Immaterial is her passive evasion) and 21 (Windranger: Windrun is cast), 7.41f.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-10-18: against evasion Eye of Skadi first for the bulk, then Silver Edge or Bloodthorn by the enemy draft (Monkey King Bar is much cheaper but answers less, e.g. Windranger); against illusions no item: find the real hero, stack Essence Shift, call the team; his own 80% tempo line. Eye of Skadi against heavy healing (it is in the build).

rules.name: Eye of Skadi
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Eye of Skadi: +35 all attributes; attacks slow movement by 25% (50% ranged) and attack speed by 25% and cut health restoration by 50% for 3 s. High-rank Slarks against Phantom Assassin or Windranger: 33% of 30 games against them (15% otherwise), won 70% against 35% (29 games). The player review: Skadi first for the bulk, then the answer to the evasion.

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: take {item} first, its attributes and slow keep you alive while attacks miss, then answer the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: спершу візьміть {item} — його атрибути й уповільнення допоможуть вижити, поки атаки промахуються, а потім відповідайте на ухилення

rules.name: Bloodthorn
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Bloodthorn: Soul Rend silences for 5 s (no Blink, Ball Lightning...) and gives True Strike against the silenced target; the passive pierces evasion on 40% of attacks. One item answers both heroes; Monkey King Bar (5000 against 6400) only pierces.

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks and {escape} escapes with {spell}: {item} silences the escape, and your attacks never miss the silenced target; Monkey King Bar is cheaper but only pierces the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак, а {escape} тікає через {spell}: {item} накладає тишу, і по цілі під тишею ваші атаки не промахуються; Monkey King Bar дешевший, але лише пробиває ухилення

rules.name: Silver Edge
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Phantom Assassin's evasion is Immaterial, a passive (25-55%); the Silver Edge attack out of Shadow Walk breaks passives for 5 s (+300 physical damage, movement capped at 200). Shadow Blade is already in his build (35%, ~23 min).

reason.en: {enemy} dodges with {spell}: the hit out of the invisibility of {item} turns it off for 5 seconds; Monkey King Bar is cheaper but only pierces the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється завдяки {spell}: удар із невидимості {item} вимикає цю здатність на 5 секунд; Monkey King Bar дешевший, але лише пробиває ухилення

rules.name: Bloodthorn
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Windranger's Windrun is cast (100% evasion from physical attacks for 3-6 s), so break does nothing; Bloodthorn's silence stops a new Windrun and gives True Strike against the silenced target. Monkey King Bar pierces 80% and is cheaper, but answers nothing else.

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: {item} silences them, and your attacks never miss the silenced target; Monkey King Bar is cheaper but only pierces the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: {item} накладає тишу, і по цілі під тишею ваші атаки не промахуються; Monkey King Bar дешевший, але лише пробиває ухилення

rules.name: Silver Edge

reason.en: {enemy} relies on {spell}: the hit out of the invisibility of {item} turns it off for 5 seconds
reason.uk: {enemy} тримається на здатності {spell}: удар із невидимості {item} вимикає її на 5 секунд

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Shadow Walk, the attack that ends the invisibility disables the target's passive abilities for 5 s, +300 physical damage and caps its movement speed at 200. Shadow Blade is in his build (35%, ~23 min): against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar finish it into Silver Edge, 36% of 44 games against them (12% otherwise), won 75% against 50%.

rules.name: Eye of Skadi

reason.en: {enemy} heals a lot: your {item} halves their health restoration, so keep it in the build
reason.uk: {enemy} багато лікується: ваш {item} удвічі ріже відновлення здоров'я, тож не пропускайте його

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Eye of Skadi: attacks cut health restoration by 50% for 3 s (+35 all attributes, the slow). It is in the build (25% of the won games, ~35 min); high-rank Slarks against heavy healers: not among the 12 items bought more often in 50 games against them. The player review: Skadi against healing for every carry who has it in the build.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: magic_wand 86% (4), power_treads 100% (6), diffusal_blade 85% (12), pers 39% (14), mage_slayer 36% (16), ultimate_scepter 74% (21), great_famango 22% (22), invis_sword 35% (23), aghanims_shard 59% (28), silver_edge 21% (28), black_king_bar 35% (29), skadi 25% (35), disperser 34% (36).

skills.basis: 370 games: maxed slark_dark_pact > slark_pounce > slark_saltwater_shiv 311 (win 50.5%), slark_dark_pact > slark_pounce 27 (win 29.6%), slark_dark_pact > slark_saltwater_shiv > slark_pounce 17 (win 58.8%); talents 10: Pounce Leash 206/368 (54.9%), Dark Pact Cooldown 162/368 (44.4%); 15: Dark Pact Damage 264/346 (50.0%), Shadow Dance Regen 82/346 (62.2%); 20: Shadow Dance Attack Speed 168/192 (60.1%), Agility gain/stolen per Essence Shift Stack 24/192 (66.7%); 25: Essence Shift Duration 58/96 (70.7%), Shadow Dance Duration 38/96 (63.2%).

suppress.illusions: Diffusal Blade and Disperser are in his build and high-rank Slarks do not buy Maelstrom against illusion heroes (Disperser 28% of games against them, 22% otherwise).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where he wins 80.0%+: 20:00 11500 (30 games, 83.3%), 30:00 17000 (93 games, 80.6%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold. No 85% line for this hero (two of the three minutes needed), so the hero's own 80% line (scripts/hero_item_stats.py WIN_TARGETS), per the player review of 2026-10-18.

notes.basis: Valve 7.41f Essence Shift steals attributes from enemy heroes he attacks; no item answers illusions for him (Diffusal and Disperser are in his build). The player review: find the real hero, stack Essence Shift on them and call the team onto the real one.

reason.uk: {enemy} б'ється ілюзіями: знайдіть справжнього героя, накопичуйте на ньому Essence Shift атаками й кличте команду бити саме його
